# AuditionMusic5

> A free web music player for the Audition Online (dance rhythm game) community.
> Listen to official Audition songs from 8 regional game servers directly in the browser.

## About

AuditionMusic5 ([auditionmusic5.com](https://auditionmusic5.com)) is a free, no-install web player for
songs from the online dance game Audition (also known as AyoDance in Indonesia).
The game stores its music in proprietary TBM/ABM container files; AuditionMusic5
loads them server-side into standard OGG Vorbis audio and streams them to any
modern browser. Login is required to play music (AM5 account, Facebook, or
Google sign-in). Downloading the original TBM file does not require login; MP3
and OGG downloads require login.

## Features

- Play Audition songs in the browser with a built-in media player
- Guitar Music mode plays backing and note audio together
- Filter the library by All Music, Ballroom Music, or Guitar Music
- Search by singer, title, music code, or BPM
- Browse song catalogs from 8 official regional Audition servers
- Download tracks as TBM, MP3, or OGG
- Save tracks to a personal cross-server playlist (login required)
- Public shoutbox for visitor chat
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers with offline cache support
- Static About/FAQ pages describe the project for search engines and AI assistants

## Servers

Song sources mirror the official patch servers of these regional Audition publishers:

- Indonesia - Audition AyoDance
- Vietnam - Audition VTC Game
- Thailand - Audition Playpark TH
- China - Audition 9You
- Korea - Audition Hanbiton
- Taiwan - Audition MangoT5
- Philippines - Audition Next Gen / Audition Playpark PH
- Latin America - Audition Axeso5

## Technical notes

- Game audio arrives as .tbm/.abm containers; the backend converts them to
  OGG Vorbis on the fly and serves them with HTTP range support.
- robots.txt is open to all crawlers, including AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot,
  PerplexityBot, Google-Extended).
- All song copyrights belong to the respective game publishers; AuditionMusic5 is
  an independent community tool and is not affiliated with them.
